name: Multichain (Anyswap)
fix_description: In anySwapOutUnderlyingWithPermit, the token parameter is not validated against a whitelist of registered AnyswapV1ERC20 tokens. Attacker passes a malicious contract as token whose underlying() returns a legitimate token (e.g. WETH), then steals funds from users who previously approved the router. Fix: validate token against a registry of authorized anyswap tokens.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a very short, single-call exploit that abuses a missing validation/trust assumption in anySwapOutUnderlyingWithPermit by passing a malicious contract as the token and stubbing the expected interface methods. It requires minimal protocol knowledge, no flash loan or multi-step state manipulation, and the PoC is well under 100 lines.
